BEGIN READ ONLY;
WITH ops AS (SELECT * FROM public.__diag_maintenance_operation WHERE active=true),
ints AS (SELECT * FROM public.kg_nodes WHERE node_type='MaintenanceInterval' AND is_active=true)
SELECT jsonb_build_object(
'operation_count',(SELECT count(*) FROM ops),
'interval_count',(SELECT count(*) FROM ints),
'exact_operation_slug_matches',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('operation_id',o.id,'operation_slug',o.slug,'node_id',n.node_id,'node_alias',n.node_alias)), '[]'::jsonb) FROM ops o JOIN ints n ON o.slug=n.node_alias),
'exact_gamme_alias_matches',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('operation_id',o.id,'operation_slug',o.slug,'related_pg_id',o.related_pg_id,'gamme_slug',o.related_gamme_slug,'node_id',n.node_id,'node_alias',n.node_alias)) FROM ops o JOIN ints n ON o.related_gamme_slug=n.node_alias),
'reused_gammes',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(d)) FROM (SELECT related_pg_id,related_gamme_slug,array_agg(slug ORDER BY slug) AS operation_slugs FROM ops WHERE related_pg_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY related_pg_id,related_gamme_slug HAVING count(*)>1) d),
'incident_edges_all_states',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.kg_edges WHERE source_node_id IN (SELECT node_id FROM ints) OR target_node_id IN (SELECT node_id FROM ints)),
'foreign_keys_to_operations_or_kg',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('table',conrelid::regclass::text,'definition',pg_get_constraintdef(oid))) FROM pg_constraint WHERE contype='f' AND confrelid IN ('public.__diag_maintenance_operation'::regclass,'public.kg_nodes'::regclass)),
'possible_bridge_columns',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('table',table_name,'column',column_name)) FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='public' AND (column_name ILIKE '%operation_id%' OR column_name ILIKE '%operation_slug%' OR column_name ILIKE '%maintenance%node%'))
) AS evidence;
COMMIT;
